subject.title: [Bug]: Non-Anthropic models output tool calls as plain text '[tool: exec]' instead of tool_use blocks

question: How should OpenClaw handle bare leaked tool markers with no arguments from tool-enabled provider routes?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the correct behavior is not mechanical because executing a marker without arguments is unsafe and fallback/retry/blocking behavior changes provider compatibility.

options.title: Retry or fail over without executing bare markers
options.body: Detect the marker, keep it out of visible replies when appropriate, and retry or fall through only through a maintainer-approved capability policy with live provider proof.

options.title: Document as unsupported provider behavior
options.body: Keep current execution behavior and improve diagnostics/docs so users know these model routes are not reliable for tool-enabled agents unless forced tool choice works.

options.title: Parse marker text into tool calls
options.body: Attempting execution from a marker alone would need a new argument-inference policy and carries the highest safety risk.

recommendation.title: Retry or fail over without executing bare markers
recommendation.body: Detect the marker, keep it out of visible replies when appropriate, and retry or fall through only through a maintainer-approved capability policy with live provider proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on provider/tool-call compatibility and adjacent fallback diagnostics makes this the strongest routing candidate from current history.
